```{r}
library(ebvcube)
library(terra)
```

## Listing all new created .nc files
```{r}
rm(list = ls())

setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
root <- '../Data_geo/' 

nc_files <- list.files(
  path = root,
  pattern = "\\.nc$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

print(nc_files)

#to simplify names

```

#  PLUM land use projection 0.01 degrees

```{r}
plum <- ebv_properties(nc_files[3], verbose=FALSE)
print(plum)

```

```{r}
slotNames(plum)
```

### cube paths to see metric names and descriptions

```{r}
plumpaths <- ebv_datacubepaths(nc_files[3], verbose = FALSE)
plumpaths
```

### change plumpaths number to check other metrics
```{r}
plum_dc <- ebv_properties(nc_files[3], plumpaths[1,1], verbose=FALSE)
plum_dc@metric
```

### spatial and temporal resolution
```{r}
# Spatial 
cat("EPSG: ", plum@spatial$epsg, "\n")
cat("Resolution: ", plum@spatial$resolution, "\n")
cat("Extent: ", plum@spatial$extent, "\n")

# Temporal
cat("Dates: ", as.character(plum@temporal$dates))
```
### data type
```{r}
# Datatype
plum_dc@ebv_cube$typ
```

```{r}
plum <- ebv_properties(nc_files[3],  verbose=FALSE)
plum@general$entity_names
```

```{r}
datacube_path <- ebv_datacubepaths(nc_files[3])
dc <- datacube_path[1,1]

start.time <- Sys.time()
data <- ebv_read(nc_files[3], dc, entity = 5, timestep = 1:1, type = 'r')
end.time <- Sys.time()

time.taken <- end.time - start.time
time.taken

# Plot data
plot(data)
```
